targetText:
It is truly wonderful how
in this credit gibberish of the money-market all categories of political
economy receive a different meaning and a different form.
explanation: Key theoretical concept in Money-Capital and Real Capital. II: Marxists analyze how structural economic conditions determine political and social relations under capitalism.

targetText:
It is at such times that the money-capitalists buy this
depreciated paper in huge quantities which in the later phases soon regains its
former level and rises above it.
explanation: Modern relevance: understanding these underlying systemic dynamics helps clarify contemporary economic policies and labor movements.
